summary: Steel lookout near Latta, Dillon County: planned in 1934, staffed by 1935-36, sold at auction in 2010. No source found on the tower or site today.

events.note: February 1934 notice of a planned fire tower to be constructed near Latta. No build date is given in the sources read.
Keeper Robert Bethea is named in a December 1935 report.
A March 1936 report says the steel tower was manned by H.L. Cottingham and had been operating since the Latta association was organized.
Sold at auction. The buyer, and whether the tower stands and where, are not given.

notes_for_editor: Only one source describes this tower's history (the Weebly compilation), and its fate is a single line: 'sold at auction' in 2010, with no buyer and no location. No source read gives its status, height or current site. The brief's coordinates (34.323656, -79.438312) come from an OSM node that cites Esri beta; they are not verified. Leads not used: a 1960 USGS topo listing for the Latta Lookout Tower (pastmaps snippet), topozone and anyplaceamerica listings (anyplaceamerica returned 403), and property listings on Fire Tower Rd in Latta, none of which are verified as this tower. The NHLR Latta page returned 404 and the SC list pages read did not include Latta. The Forestry Commission post (source 2) is a general statement about the whole tower system and does not name Latta, so it is used for context only and is not an event for this tower. Brief status and access stay unknown.
